TYPE_CREDIT_CARD_FRAUD.description: Credit card transaction fraud, counterfeit magstripe abuse, and high-velocity unauthorized purchases

hypotheses.title: Automated Card Testing Botnet

falsification_criteria.description: Normal organic transaction velocity refutes high-frequency automated card bot
Zero transaction errors refutes automated credential and CVV guessing script

hypotheses.title: Syndicated Carding Ring

falsification_criteria.description: Zero correlation across payment card issuer BIN trees and linked syndicate nodes
Cryptographically verified EMV chip refutes cloned counterfeit card
